title: Zhipu AI GLM 5.3 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body:
Model Serving now supports [GLM 5.3](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#glm-5-3) as a Databricks-hosted model in supported US and Americas regions. This text-only mixture of experts (MoE) model supports a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens, up to 65,536 output tokens, function calling, structured output, coding, agentic tool use, and always-on reasoning. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
